plan: The dominant strategy in this auction game is to bid your private value, which in this case is $40. This strategy maximizes expected profit because it balances the risk of overbidding and paying too much with the risk of underbidding and losing the prize. Since this is the only round, there is no historical data to consider, and the values are independently drawn. Therefore, I will bid exactly my private value of $40.

The dominant strategy in this auction game is to bid your value, which economists suggest maximizes profit over time. Given that the values are redrawn independently each round and this is the only round, my value is $13. By bidding my value, I ensure that if I win, my profit is maximized because I pay the second-highest bid, which is likely less than my value. This approach minimizes risk and aligns with optimal strategy.
